source_review.notes: Checked the authoritative OpenAPI 3.2.0 specification and official release announcement, RFC 3986 URI resolution, RFC 9110 HTTP semantics, JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 Core, and RFC 9457 Problem Details. Confirmed 3.2.0 as the latest published OAS and checked root fields, $self, paths, components including mediaTypes, security, callbacks, webhooks, and base-URI rules against the normative text.

evidence: Reviewed graph G=(N,E), description tuple D=(d_0,N,E,B), operation-set comprehension, injective operation identity, and path-template equality notation against the prose.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Every symbol is introduced, GitHub math delimiters are balanced, and automated diagnostics report no issue.

evidence: Executed the bounded structure checker and recomputed two operations, one effective path parameter, and four response entries.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Counts and emitted operation identifiers match the declared fixture.

evidence: Checked rooted graph reachability, operationId injectivity, template-to-parameter set equality, and security OR-of-AND logic against examples and answers.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The graph model distinguishes containment, explicit URI references, and defined implicit name connections without treating all edges as JSON Schema references.

evidence: Reviewed missing and relative $self, offline retrieval, duplicate YAML keys, ambiguous paths, missing or extra path parameters, empty responses, anonymous security overrides, callback SSRF, unresolved targets, decimal loss, and multi-document bundling.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Parser, resolver, schema, semantic lint, HTTP, security, generator, and deployment boundaries remain distinct.

evidence: Checked version clarity, canonical base resolution, typed component references, operation identity, template binding, inheritance, media-type ownership, response coverage, and security logic across all examples and exercises.
invariant_checking.notes: No section treats a component as active without a connection or a structurally valid description as implementation conformance.

proof_review.notes: No formal theorem or general OpenAPI conformance proof is claimed.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No proof sketch is claimed; the graph and set equations are review models.

evidence: The Python checker is explicitly labeled a bounded in-memory subset rather than an OpenAPI parser, validator, or service-conformance test.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Generated artifact, traffic comparison, and multi-tool evidence claims are scoped to what each observation establishes.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed the full object graph from root through servers, paths, Path Items, Operations, inputs, bodies, responses, components, security, callbacks, webhooks, and multi-document resolution.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed exact OAS 3.2 root requirements, JSON/YAML portability, parameter serialization, response headers and content, component namespaces, security overrides, callbacks, URI registries, layered linting, generation, and publication guidance.

pedagogical_review.notes: Reviewed first-principles traversal, four annotated YAML fragments, one executable structural fixture, ten distinct worked examples, and five exercises progressing from object navigation to multi-document and verification design.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
